content: Hessa gishshas Dawiti, «Godaa Xoossaa keeththinne Isra7eele asay xuugettiza yarsho yarshizasoy hayssan dees» gides.
Xoossa Keeth Keexxanaas Giigeteth
Kawo Dawiti Isra7eele biittan diza hara dere asay issi bolla shiiqana mala azazides; istta giddofe Xoossa Keeththaa keexxanaas masettida shuch giigsanaas shuch qerizayta giigsides.
Dawiti gimbaa pengetas misimaarenne maaxafa gidana mala daro biratanne meezaaneppe bolla gidida keehi daro xarqimala giigsides.
Sidoona asaynne Xiroose asay daro ziga mith ehiza gishshas qooday baynda keehi daro ziga mith giigsides.

Dawiti, «Ta naa Solomooney yelaganne oosaara meezetonttayssa; Godaa Xoossaas keexettana keeththay biitta ubbaan erettida lo7onne puula keeth gidanaas bessees; hessa gishshas izas koshshizayssa tani giigsana» gides; Dawiti hayqqanaappe sinththan daro miish giigsides.
Hessafe guye Dawiti ba naa Solomoone xeygidi GODAA Isra7eele Xoossa Keeththaa keexxana mala azazides.
Dawiti Solomoone, «Ta naazoo, tani GODAA ta Xoossaa bonchchos Keeththe keexxanaas ta wozinan qoppadis.
Gido attiin Godaa Xoossaa qaalay tana, ‹Neni daro suuth gussadasa; daro olakka olettadasa; neni sa7a bolla ta sinththan daro suuth gussida gishshas neni taas Keeththe keexxana mala koykke› gides.

Gidikkoka, ‹Saroninne woppan ayssiza naa ne yelana; ubbaa baggara diza morkketappe ta iza shempisana; iza sunththika Solomoone geetettana; iza kawoteththa layth ubbaan tani Isra7eeles saronne woppa immana.
Izi ta bonchchos Keeththe keexxana; izi taas naa gidana; tanikka izas aawa gidana; iza kawoteththa araatay Isra7eele bolla mernaas minni daana› giidi hidota immides.
«Ha7ikka ta naazoo! GODAY nenara gido; izi nees immida hidota qaalaa mala GODAA ne Xoossaa keeth keexxanaassinne polanaas nena gaththo.
GODAY nena Isra7eele bolla kawoththida wode GODAA ne Xoossaa wogaa neni naagana mala Xoossi nees aadho erateththinne akeeka immo.
GODAY Muse baggara Isra7eeles immida wogaanne maaraa ne naagikko ubbayka nees injje gidana; aykkoy baa, yayyofa, minna, murtta, hidota qanxxofa.

«Tani ta wolqqay gaththida mala Godaa Xoossaa Keeththe keexxanaas 3,400 kilo giraame gidiza worqqanne 34,000 kilo giraame gidiza bira shiishshadis; qasseka keehi daro xarqimalanne birata, miththinne shuch giigsadis; hessa bolla gujissizayssa neni gujja.
Ne matan dumma dumma ooso eriza hiillati deettes; shuch qerizaytinne massizayti, anaaxetinne ubba ooso ooththanaas dandayza hiillati deettes.
Worqqa, bira, xarqimalanne birata ooson erettida dumma dumma hiillati nees deettes; ha7i neni oosoza doomma; GODAY nenara gido» gides.
Dawiti Isra7eele deraa kaaleththizayta ubbaa ba naa Solomoone maaddana mala,

«GODAA intte Xoossay hayssa gakkanaas inttenara dees gidennee? Izi inttena ubbasora shempisibeennee? Ha biittan diza asaa izi ta kushen aaththi immida gishshas ha biittaya Godaa Xoossassinne iza deraas haarettadus.

Hessa gishshas GODAA intte Xoossaa koyanaas intte wozinanne intte shemppo immite; GODAA Xoossaa bonchchos keexettida keeththaan Xoossa Taabotaanne Xoossas dummatida miishshata ehidi woththana mala intte dendidi GODAA Keeththe keexxite» gi azazides.
